description: This file defines the Java class JmsBasedTenantClient, which is a JMS-based implementation of TenantClient. It provides methods to create a client, retrieve tenant information by ID or subject DN, and send arbitrary search requests to the Tenant service using JMS messages. The class extends a generic request-response client tailored for TenantResult and TenantObject payloads.

classes.name: JmsBasedTenantClient
classes.description: A JMS-based implementation of TenantClient that provides methods to retrieve tenant information via JMS messaging, including creation, search by tenant ID or subject DN, and sending custom requests. Extends JmsBasedRequestResponseClient to handle request-response patterns with TenantResult payloads.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new JmsBasedTenantClient instance and initializes necessary links. Returns a Future encapsulating the client or failure.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information by tenant ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information using the X500Principal's distinguished name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sends a search request with arbitrary criteria as a Buffer.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JMS request message with specified operation and search criteria, processes response, and handles status codes.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Processes the response payload and status code to produce a TenantResult object, handling JSON parsing errors.
